mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS changes by <=0.1% over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction, increasing recession risk and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months, SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a month-over-month decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes, RSAFS declines >0.5% MoM are followed by positive 20-day SPX returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, triggering tighter monetary policy and higher equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in <45% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.2% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 2.0% signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST increases >2.0% MoM, SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously for two consecutive months, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% YoY), a month-over-month decline in industrial production signals deepening economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In manufacturing slowdown regimes, INDPRO declines MoM are followed by positive 5-day SPX returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
